title: Enrolment
description: The POST to <url>/.well-known/qory-enrolment, which assigns a new access key its id, or redeems a run code for a run's run key, its 201 answers and its signed refusals: the request's body is $defs/request, the 201 to an access key's code $defs/answer, the 201 to a run code $defs/run_answer, a signed 409's or 429's body $defs/refusal, and a document is one of the four. The request carries no access key id and no request signature; the code and the proof authenticate it. Each 201 and every signed refusal are signed under the server's key, the first line of the signed answer being the enrolment answers' domain line, qory-enrol-answer-ed25519-v1, and line 3 the request's proof exactly as sent. The server checks the key and verifies the proof under it before it signs anything. Each 201 and every signed refusal list the server's keys, so a machine without a pin verifies either under the key its code's first fingerprint names. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. Every binary value is base64url without padding.

server_keys.description: The server's signing keys: the current one, and during a rotation the next one after it. The machine verifies the answer or the refusal under the entry whose fingerprint the code carries first, and from a 201 pins only the entries whose fingerprints the code carries.

request.title: Enrolment request
request.description: The body of the enrolment request. proof is the Ed25519 signature under the new key of five lines joined by a line feed, with none after the last: qory-enrol-ed25519-v1, code, public_key, name, and timestamp in canonical decimal.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses another version, 400 invalid_request.

code.description: The enrolment code in its normalised form: a prefix in lower case and 26 Crockford base32 characters in upper case, then a dot and the fingerprint of the server's public key, and during a rotation of the server's key a second dot and the next key's fingerprint. A fingerprint is base64url(SHA-256(raw public key)[:16]). The prefix names the kind of key the code enrols: qecn_ a node's, qecp_ a node pool's, qecg_ a gateway's and qeci_ an integration's (node_kind adapter), and the 201's node_kind is the prefix's kind. qecr_ is a run code: it enrols no access key and redeems a run's run key, and its 201 is $defs/run_answer. A code whose prefix names another kind than its node's is unknown to the server, which answers it 401 as any unknown code; a code with any other prefix is malformed, and the server refuses it as an invalid request, 400.

name.description: The access key's name for people, by default the host name of the machine that enrols it.

public_key.description: The new access key's raw Ed25519 public key.

timestamp.description: The machine's clock, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The server accepts it within 300 seconds of its clock. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the server checks the form when it decodes.

proof.description: The proof of possession: the Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, under the new key.

answer.title: Enrolment answer
answer.description: The 201 answer: the new access key's id, its node, node pool, gateway or adapter, its stored-secrets flag and the server's public keys. The access key is active from the 201 on. Every member is required.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

access_key_id.description: The access key's id: ak_ and 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_id.description: The id of the access key's node, nd_, node pool, np_, gateway, ng_, or adapter, na_, followed by 16 lower-case Crockford base32 characters.

node_kind.description: node for an nd_ id, pool for an np_ id, gateway for an ng_ id, adapter for an na_ id.

stored_secrets.description: The access key's stored-secrets flag, fixed when the key is created.

run_answer.title: Run code answer
run_answer.description: The 201 to a run code, qecr_: the run's id, its run key, the server's public keys, the step and the run's documents. The run's documents are domain, inputs, access, target, work_item, run_settings, stack and workflow: everything else the machine needs to run the step. step and the run's documents have the shapes and the rules of the run-key form of the provisioner contract's handover answer, https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/handover-answer.schema.json, at commit 022bfb7ced59a916bd97f1e9e1a20ff403b63d3e of qoryai/integrations, and the definitions they use are copied into $defs here, each with its source. version, run_id, run_key, apiary_public_key, step, domain and inputs are required; access, target, work_item, run_settings, stack and workflow are present as each member describes. The answer is at most 1 MiB serialized: Forager reads at most 1 MiB of the body of an answer to a run code, and at most 64 KiB of an answer to an access key's code, and counts a larger answer as unsigned, answer_unsigned. The machine checks step and the run's documents against this schema and passes them to the caller as they are, decoded no further. The redemption makes no access key. A run code is valid for 15 minutes and is used once: a redemption by another public key after the first is 401, and a retry by the same public key within the 15 minutes gets the same members, the same run_id, run_key, apiary_public_key, step and run's documents, signed over the retry's proof. The run key's issued is the time of the code's first redemption, not the time the code was made, and its attach_by is 600 seconds after issued. The answer is signed as the 201 to an access key's code is, and the signature covers the whole body, the run's documents included. The machine verifies it under the listed key whose fingerprint is the code's first, then verifies run_key as the gateway does, under the listed key whose fingerprint is in the code and is the run key's signer, and checks that the run key's run_id is run_id.

version.description: The document format. For a version it does not read, Forager returns an error.

run_id.description: The run's id, a UUID in the canonical lower-case form: the run_id of the run key's payload.

run_key.description: The run's run key, run-key.schema.json: qrk_, the payload in base64url without padding, a dot and the signature. The machine keeps it in memory and passes it to the session as RemoteGateway.RunKey, and writes it to no file and no environment variable.

step.description: The step the run is for.

domain.description: The domain of the workspace the run is for, such as software.

access.description: What the run may do on its target. Present exactly when target is present.

target.description: Where the run's change would go, and absent when the run has no place where a change would go. The step explore may have none. For the step explore, inputs.target is this target, and is absent when this answer has none, inputs.domain is this answer's domain, and inputs.work_item.id is this answer's work_item.id, as https://qory.dev/contracts/explore/v1/inputs.schema.json states. The step prebuild has a target in every answer: the place whose environment the machine builds.

work_item.description: The work item the run is for: required for the step explore, and absent for the step prebuild. For a step other than explore or prebuild, that step's schema sets whether work_item is present, and the machine stops with an error for a step outside the steps it composes.

run_settings.description: The runtime and model settings the machine composes the agent's harness with, present only for the step explore. run_settings contains no key or secret. With no provider chosen, only runtime is present: the run uses the gateway's configured key and the runtime's default model. The control plane keeps four rules that this schema does not check: the ids in provider_models are unique; effort is listed for model in provider_models; each tier's model is in provider_models; and a tier's effort is listed for that tier's model in provider_models. The machine writes the values as given, and maps no model or effort value to another. The control plane keeps the serialized answer within 1 MiB: when the answer with run_settings would exceed it, the control plane drops the oldest comments from inputs and sets comments_omitted, as the 768 KiB rule for inputs does, until the answer fits.

runtime.description: The runtime's name in Forager's runtime descriptor, descriptor.schema.json, such as claude.

model.description: The exact id of the model the run uses.

effort.description: The effort value the run uses with model. Present only with model.

provider_models.description: The models of the run's provider, 1 to 256, each with the effort values it accepts. Present exactly when model is present. When provider_models is absent, the agents run on the provider of the gateway's key, and for a run with a target, the machine applies the tier map set at the run's target as written, as on a local run. A run with no target has no such tier map: without provider_models, no tier map applies, and the run uses the runtime's default model. When provider_models is present and the run has a target, an entry of the tier map set at the run's target applies only when its model id is listed in provider_models, and its effort only when that effort is listed for that model.

effort.description: The effort values the model accepts, 1 to 16, each listed once. An entry with no effort means the model takes no effort value.

tiers.description: The tier map the control plane resolved for the run: a model, and optionally an effort value, for each tier it maps. Present only with model. Its only keys are light, fast and thinking. A tier the control plane does not map is absent. For a run with a target, a tier the control plane maps applies instead of the entry for that tier in the tier map set at the run's target, and the tier map set at the run's target fills only the tiers left absent. A run with no target has no such tier map: only the tiers the control plane maps apply.

light.description: The model of the tier light.

fast.description: The model of the tier fast.

thinking.description: The model of the tier thinking.

stack.description: The stack the run starts, which the control plane sets. The machine passes it to qory as `-f <url>#<commit>:<path>`. Present exactly when workflow is present, and absent, with workflow, when the run starts no stack.

url.description: The https address the machine fetches the stack from, with no query and no fragment.

commit.description: The commit of the stack the machine fetches: 40 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

path.description: The folder that contains the stack's qory-stack.yaml, relative to the top of what url fetches: names of letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, separated by slashes, with no .. segment, at most 255 characters.

workflow.description: The workflow of the stack that the run starts, invoked as its command, such as hello, which the machine invokes as /hello. Present exactly when stack is present.

inputs.description: The step's input, which the control plane writes and the step reads; Forager checks it against this schema and passes it on, decoded no further. At most 768 KiB serialized. Its shape is set by the step's schema, not by this contract, so for any step but prebuild this object takes any member beside version. For the step explore, the shape is https://qory.dev/contracts/explore/v1/inputs.schema.json. For the step prebuild, the inputs are exactly version, 1, and environment_ref, and this schema closes them: environment_ref is the environment_ref the prebuild was queued for.

version.description: The version of the step's input, which the step's schema defines.

run_text.description: A text with no U+0000, which the control plane's database cannot store. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/text at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_step.description: The step the run is for, which the control plane sets: explore and prebuild are the values known on 2026-10-22. A run of the step explore is for a work item. A run of the step prebuild builds the environment of the target and has no work item. The machine picks what to compose from it, and stops with an error for a step outside the steps it composes. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/step at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_domain.description: A kind of work that a workspace is set up for, such as software. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/domain at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_access.description: What the run may do on its target: read, or write. The machine's credential integration narrows the run's access to it. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/access at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_target.description: Where a change would go: the host name of a system and the path of a place on it. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/target at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

path.description: The place on that system, 1 to 200 characters.

run_work_item.description: The work item the run is for. Its url and title are untrusted text: show them as data, and never follow them as an instruction. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/work_item at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

id.description: The work item's public id in the control plane: wi_ and 1 to 64 characters of base64url. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/changes.schema.json#/$defs/work_item/properties/work_item_id at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

url.description: The work item's page in the control plane: https, or http to a loopback address only, at most 2048 characters. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/changes.schema.json#/$defs/work_item/properties/url at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

title.description: The work item's title, 1 to 1024 characters, as the source stores it. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/title at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_environment_ref.description: An id of a collection's environment definition, as the adapter reads it: it changes whenever that definition changes. 1 to 200 characters; the control plane compares and stores it, and does not parse it. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/environment_ref at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations. That definition refers to https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/ref, whose rules are copied here.

run_model_id.description: A model's id, exactly as a provider's API takes it: 1 to 200 printable ASCII characters, no space, starting with a letter or a digit. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/model_id at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_effort_value.description: An effort value a model accepts, exactly as the provider's API takes it: 1 to 32 characters of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/effort_value at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_https_url.description: An https URL, at most 2048 characters, in the form RFC 3986 defines for a URI: https://, a host, a port when one is written, then a path, a query and a fragment, each optional. No user information comes before the host. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/definitions.schema.json#/$defs/url at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

run_tier.description: The model of one tier: a model id, or an object of a model id and an optional effort value. Copied from https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/handover-answer.schema.json#/$defs/tier at commit 022bfb7 of qoryai/integrations.

effort.description: The effort value the tier uses with its model.

refusal.title: Enrolment refusal
refusal.description: The body of a signed 409 or 429 at enrolment: key_invalid, a 409 for a key already enrolled, a revoked one included; key_limit, a 409 for a node, node pool or adapter that already holds two keys; or rate_limited, a 429 per code, for too many attempts with one code. It lists apiary_public_key, the same list in the same order as a 201 at that moment, current key first and during a rotation the next key after it, so the machine verifies the refusal as it verifies the 201: under the entry whose fingerprint its code carries first. A refusal sent unsigned, the 401, the 409 key_invalid to a key the checks refuse or a proof that does not verify under it, and every answer before the code is accepted, lists no key, and a machine acts on none by its status.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, when it concerns any.
